description: A left cerebellar mass with cystic and solid components, showing no diffusion restriction and foci of low signal on SWI (compatible with hemorrhage or calcification). The solid component demonstrates vivid enhancement and surrounding edema and compresses the fourth ventricle, resulting in hydrocephalus.
